retryOn.description: Substrings that mark an error as worth another go. A regex would be more expressive and less reviewable; an operator reads this list and knows what it does.

backoffMs.description: Base delay, multiplied by the attempt number. heddle clamps any single wait to 30s.

substitute.description: The output to stand in when the retries are spent. Omit it and the error stands.

guard.description: Tool name to the argument patterns it may not carry.

maxResultBytes.description: A result longer than this is replaced with a note. The model pays for every byte of it.

callsPerMinute.description: Model calls this process may make in a rolling minute, across every run it is serving.

retryOn.description: Substrings that mark a failed model call as worth re-issuing. Admitted here and nowhere else: a failed model call has changed nothing.
